title: Kizoku Tensei: Megumareta Umare kara Saikyou no Chikara wo Eru
englishTitle: Noble Reincarnation: Born Blessed, So I'll Obtain Ultimate Power
title_english: Noble Reincarnation: Born Blessed, So I'll Obtain Ultimate Power

alternative_titles.en: Noble Reincarnation: Born Blessed, So I'll Obtain Ultimate Power
alternative_titles.ja: 貴族転生 ～恵まれた生まれから最強の力を得る～

synopsis:
Noah Ararat is born into privilege as the 13th prince of an imperial dynasty and granted an existence most can only envy. After all, apart from the access to the empire's finest education and resources, Noah is a reincarnator with the memories of his previous life intact, blessed with an infinite level cap and an elite ability that allows him to utilize his subordinates' skills.

Within the imperial court, however, status alone offers no guarantee of safety. While Noah's overwhelming potential sets him apart from his siblings from the moment he begins his training, it also draws the attention of nobles whose interests extend far beyond governance. Inevitably, Noah must learn to navigate the expectations of royalty and the mechanics of his unusual power, as he realizes that privilege invites control as readily as it grants it.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
synopsis_es:
Noah Ararat nace con el privilegio de ser el decimotercer príncipe de una dinastía imperial y se le concede una existencia que la mayoría sólo puede envidiar. Después de todo, aparte del acceso a la mejor educación y recursos del imperio, Noah es un reencarnador con los recuerdos de su vida anterior intactos, bendecido con un límite de nivel infinito y una habilidad de élite que le permite utilizar las habilidades de sus subordinados.

Sin embargo, dentro de la corte imperial el estatus por sí solo no ofrece garantía de seguridad. Si bien el abrumador potencial de Noah lo distingue de sus hermanos desde el momento en que comienza su entrenamiento, también llama la atención de los nobles cuyos intereses se extienden mucho más allá del gobierno. Inevitablemente, Noah debe aprender a navegar las expectativas de la realeza y los mecanismos de su inusual poder, al darse cuenta de que el privilegio invita al control tan fácilmente como lo otorga.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: Thirteenth Imperial Prince Noah Ararat
episodes_data.description: An ordinary village boy wakes up to find he`s been reborn as Noah Ararat, the thirteenth prince of the empire.

episodes_data.title: The Birth of the Songstress
episodes_data.description: While walking through the city, Noah enters a venue and is left speechless by the talent of a singer.

episodes_data.title: Those Gained, Those Lost
episodes_data.description: Noah gains another powerful subordinate, but suffers a blow when a rebellion breaks out in Almeria.

episodes_data.title: The Almerian Rebellion
episodes_data.description: Noah deals with the rebel forces leading an uprising in his domain.

episodes_data.title: People Are Treasures
episodes_data.description: Noah makes it his goal to show his thanks to the people who have given him their loyalty and cooperation.

episodes_data.title: Dark Clouds
episodes_data.description: Now twelve years old, Noah is recognized for his exceptional knowledge of military affairs and imperial law.

episodes_data.title: The Emperor's Wishes
episodes_data.description: When followers of the crown prince attempt an insurrection, Noah begins to question the emperor`s intentions.

episodes_data.title: The First Vesus the Thirteenth
episodes_data.description: Noah encounters a man doing evil deeds in the name of his brother Gilbert, the first prince.

episodes_data.title: The Highest Trust
episodes_data.description: Noah catches a spy in the act and learns of a plot against the emperor`s life.

episodes_data.title: Lightning Prince and Wise Prince
episodes_data.description: The emperor suggests a potential wife for Noah: the granddaughter of his uncle, Indra the Lightning Prince.

episodes_data.title: Disinheritance
episodes_data.description: The emperor makes the decision to disinherit the crown prince... but not before seeking Noah`s advice.

episodes_data.title: Nobility
episodes_data.description: Noah catches Albert in the act of attempting a coup and gives him one last chance to repent.
